description: Dallas Central Appraisal District certified data for tax years 2022 to 2025 (one source per year). See docs/registry/texas-sources.md, 'Prior-year rolls'.

sources.license: Public record; no license or terms of use stated. The page only notes that DCAD cannot provide technical support for use of the data
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Prior-year roll, tax year 2022: same host, page and ViewPDFs.aspx path as the 2026 files of tx-dallas-cad, whose terms were reviewed 2026-11-02 (not re-read for this entry). Links are the hrefs on DataProducts.aspx as of 2026-11-10 (folder case varies on the page; the 2022 _CURRENT link uses 'data products'). HEAD 2026-11-10: both 200; DCAD2022_CERTIFIED_07252022.ZIP 192,175,890 B (roll at certification), DCAD2022_CURRENT.zip 200,198,749 B (certified plus supplements). No Last-Modified header from DCAD. File layout not opened: ViewPDFs.aspx ignores Range requests, so a zip cannot be probed without downloading it; sizes are within 5 percent of the 2026 files, so the same layout is expected, and each zip ships its own layout documents. The separate 2022_REAL_PROPERTY_CERT_APPR_ROLL.zip and BPP files on the page are a different product and not configured. robots.txt disallows only staff/test paths and /Acct detail pages.
